Apple___Apple_scab.organic: Apply sulfur or copper-based fungicides early in the season. Remove and destroy fallen leaves. Prune for better air circulation.
Apple___Apple_scab.chemical: Use fungicides containing myclobutanil, fenbuconazole, or captan. Apply at green tip, pink bud, and petal fall stages.
Apple___Apple_scab.prevention: Plant resistant varieties (Liberty, Enterprise, GoldRush). Rake and destroy fallen leaves. Avoid overhead irrigation.
Apple___Apple_scab.severity: Can cause 70-100% crop loss if untreated

Apple___Black_rot.organic: Remove mummified fruit and cankers. Apply copper sprays. Prune infected branches.
Apple___Black_rot.chemical: Apply captan or mancozeb fungicides from pink bud through harvest. Use thiophanate-methyl for cankers.
Apple___Black_rot.prevention: Sanitation - remove all mummies and dead wood. Prune for air flow. Avoid wounding fruit.
Apple___Black_rot.severity: Fruit rot and cankers can kill limbs

Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.organic: Remove nearby junipers/cedars if possible. Apply sulfur or neem oil. Use resistant varieties.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.chemical: Apply myclobutanil, fenarimol, or triadimefon at pink bud and petal fall.
Apple___Cedar_apple_rust.prevention: Plant resistant apple varieties. Remove alternate hosts (junipers) within 1km. Avoid overhead watering.

Apple___healthy.organic: No treatment needed. Continue good cultural practices.
Apple___healthy.prevention: Maintain regular pruning, balanced fertilization, and pest monitoring.

Blueberry___healthy.organic: No treatment needed. Maintain acidic soil (pH 4.5-5.5).
Blueberry___healthy.prevention: Mulch with pine bark. Irrigate with acidified water. Monitor for pests.

Cherry___Powdery_mildew.organic: Apply sulfur or potassium bicarbonate. Prune for air circulation. Remove infected leaves.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Use myclobutanil, fenbuconazole, or propiconazole. Apply at first sign and repeat.
Cherry___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Plant resistant varieties. Avoid excess nitrogen. Ensure good air flow.

Cherry___healthy.prevention: Prune annually. Monitor for pests. Fertilize appropriately.

Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.organic: Rotate crops (2+ years). Use resistant hybrids. Tillage to bury residue.
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.chemical: Apply pyraclostrobin, azoxystrobin, or propiconazole at VT-R1 stage.
Corn___Cercospora_leaf_spot Gray_leaf_sp.prevention: Crop rotation. Resistant hybrids. Balanced fertility. Scout early.

Corn___Common_rust.organic: Plant resistant hybrids. Early planting to avoid peak spore loads.
Corn___Common_rust.chemical: Fungicides rarely needed. If severe, use azoxystrobin or pyraclostrobin.
Corn___Common_rust.prevention: Resistant hybrids. Early planting. Monitor southern winds for spores.
Corn___Common_rust.severity: Usually minor, can reduce yield in severe cases

Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.organic: Crop rotation. Resistant hybrids. Tillage. Remove debris.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.chemical: Apply azoxystrobin, pyraclostrobin, or propiconazole at VT-R1.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.prevention: Rotation with non-host crops. Resistant hybrids. Residue management.
Corn___Northern_Leaf_Blight.severity: Significant yield loss in susceptible hybrids

Corn___healthy.prevention: Crop rotation. Balanced fertility. Weed control. Scout regularly.

Grape___Black_rot.organic: Remove mummies. Apply copper or sulfur. Prune for air flow.
Grape___Black_rot.chemical: Use mancozeb, ziram, or myclobutanil. Critical sprays at bloom and post-bloom.
Grape___Black_rot.prevention: Sanitation - remove all mummies. Canopy management. Resistant varieties.

Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).organic: No cure. Remove infected vines. Manage water stress.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).chemical: No effective chemical control. Preventive pruning wound protection.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).prevention: Use clean planting material. Protect pruning wounds. Avoid stress.
Grape___Esca_(Black_Measles).severity: Chronic decline, vine death. No cure.

Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.organic: Remove infected leaves. Copper sprays. Improve air circulation.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.chemical: Apply mancozeb or copper hydroxide. Start at 3-5 inch shoot growth.
Grape___Leaf_blight_(Isariopsis_Leaf_Spo.prevention: Canopy management. Remove leaf debris. Avoid overhead irrigation.

Grape___healthy.prevention: Canopy management. Balanced nutrition. Disease monitoring.

Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).organic: No cure. Remove infected trees. Control psyllid vector with oils/soaps.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).chemical: Systemic insecticides for psyllid control (imidacloprid, thiamethoxam). No cure for bacteria.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).prevention: Use certified disease-free nursery trees. Psyllid management. Quarantine compliance.
Orange___Haunglongbing_(Citrus_greening).severity: Fatal. Tree death in 3-5 years. No cure.

Peach___Bacterial_spot.organic: Copper sprays at bud break. Resistant varieties. Avoid overhead irrigation.
Peach___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Resistant varieties. Pruning for air flow. Avoid wounding. Sanitation.

Peach___healthy.prevention: Annual pruning. Thinning. Balanced fertilization. Pest monitoring.

Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.organic: Copper sprays. Resistant varieties. Hot water seed treatment. Crop rotation.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Resistant varieties. Pathogen-free seeds. Drip irrigation. Rotation.
Pepper,_bell___Bacterial_spot.severity: Fruit spots, leaf drop, yield loss

Pepper,_bell___healthy.prevention: Crop rotation. Disease-free transplants. Drip irrigation. Mulching.

Potato___Early_blight.organic: Crop rotation. Resistant varieties. Mulch. Copper sprays.
Potato___Early_blight.chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or azoxystrobin. Start at row closure.
Potato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotation (3+ years). Certified seed. Balanced N. Avoid stress.

Potato___Late_blight.organic: Copper sprays. Destroy volunteers. Resistant varieties. Wide spacing.
Potato___Late_blight.chemical: Mancozeb, chlorothalonil, cymoxanil, or fluazinam. Weekly in conducive weather.
Potato___Late_blight.prevention: Certified seed. Eliminate cull piles. Forecast models. Resistant varieties.
Potato___Late_blight.severity: Can destroy crop in days. Irish famine pathogen.

Potato___healthy.prevention: Certified seed. Rotation. Hilling. Balanced nutrition. Scout weekly.

Raspberry___healthy.prevention: Remove old canes. Trellis for air flow. Mulch. Monitor for viruses.

Soybean___healthy.prevention: Rotation. Resistant varieties. Seed treatment. Scout for pests.

Squash___Powdery_mildew.organic: Neem oil, potassium bicarbonate, sulfur. Resistant varieties. Spacing.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.chemical: Myclobutanil, triflumizole, or quinoxyfen. Rotate modes of action.
Squash___Powdery_mildew.prevention: Resistant varieties. Wide spacing. Drip irrigation. Remove crop debris.

Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.organic: Remove infected leaves. Mulch. Avoid overhead watering. Resistant varieties.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.chemical: Captan, thiophanate-methyl, or myclobutanil. Apply at renovation.
Strawberry___Leaf_scorch.prevention: Resistant varieties. Renovation. Mulch. Drip irrigation. Rotation.

Strawberry___healthy.prevention: Renovation. Mulch. Disease-free plants. Rotation. Weed control.

Tomato___Bacterial_spot.organic: Copper sprays. Resistant varieties. Hot water seed treatment. Mulch.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.prevention: Pathogen-free seeds/transplants. Drip irrigation. Rotation. Mulch.
Tomato___Bacterial_spot.severity: Fruit lesions, defoliation, major yield loss

Tomato___Early_blight.organic: Mulch. Stake/prune. Copper or sulfur. Remove lower leaves. Rotation.
Tomato___Early_blight.chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, azoxystrobin, or boscalid. Start at first fruit.
Tomato___Early_blight.prevention: Rotation. Mulch. Staking. Resistant varieties. Balanced fertility.

Tomato___Late_blight.organic: Copper sprays. Resistant varieties (Defiant, Mountain Magic). Destroy volunteers.
Tomato___Late_blight.chemical: Mancozeb, chlorothalonil, cymoxanil, fluopicolide. Preventive schedule.
Tomato___Late_blight.prevention: Resistant varieties. Eliminate volunteers. Forecast alerts. Drip irrigation.
Tomato___Late_blight.severity: Rapid crop destruction. Same pathogen as Irish potato famine.

Tomato___Leaf_Mold.organic: Reduce humidity. Increase air flow. Remove infected leaves. Sulfur.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.chemical: Mancozeb, difenoconazole, or cyprodinil+fludioxonil. Greenhouse: ventilation.
Tomato___Leaf_Mold.prevention: Ventilation. Resistant varieties. Avoid overhead water. Wider spacing.

Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.organic: Mulch. Stake. Remove lower leaves. Copper sprays. Rotation (3 years).
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or azoxystrobin. Start at first fruit set.
Tomato___Septoria_leaf_spot.prevention: Rotation. Mulch. Staking. Drip irrigation. Remove debris.

Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.organic: Insecticidal soap, neem oil, horticultural oil. Predatory mites. Water spray.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.chemical: Abamectin, bifenazate, spiromesifen. Rotate modes of action.
Tomato___Spider_mites Two-spotted_spider.prevention: Avoid dust. Adequate irrigation. Scout undersides. Encourage predators.

Tomato___Target_Spot.organic: Rotation. Mulch. Stake. Remove debris. Copper sprays.
Tomato___Target_Spot.chemical: Chlorothalonil, mancozeb, or azoxystrobin. Start at flowering.
Tomato___Target_Spot.prevention: Rotation. Resistant varieties. Mulch. Air circulation. Sanitation.

Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.organic: Remove infected plants. Reflective mulch. Whitefly control (soap, oil).
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.chemical: Imidacloprid, thiamethoxam for whitefly vector. No cure for virus.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.prevention: Resistant varieties (TYLCV-resistant). Whitefly management. Weed-free borders.
Tomato___Tomato_Yellow_Leaf_Curl_Virus.severity: Stunted growth, no fruit. No cure. Remove plants.

Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.organic: Remove infected plants. Disinfect tools (bleach). No smoking near plants.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.chemical: No chemical control. Virus management only.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.prevention: Resistant varieties. Sanitation. Seed treatment. Avoid handling when wet.
Tomato___Tomato_mosaic_virus.severity: Mosaic, distortion, yield loss. Persists in soil/debris.

Tomato___healthy.prevention: Rotation. Staking. Mulch. Drip irrigation. Disease-free transplants. Scout.
